description: Shared urgency/priority classifier for the harness. Referenced by harness-checkin, /standup, and `harness dashboard` so every surface classifies and orders work the same way instead of ad-hoc sorting by due date. Adapted from the July 2026 'Jarvis' Engineering Show & Tell POC (urgency matrix: actionable vs. knowledge, P1/P2, leadership flag). Classification is read-only — it never triggers a mutation.

kinds.actionable: Needs an action from the user (reply, review, fix, decide, create). Belongs on the action list.
kinds.to_review: Background reading to stay informed; do if time permits. Not a commitment.
kinds.knowledge: Reference/context only — file it in the vault, no action expected.

P1.meaning: Do today. Blocking someone, customer/production impact, or a hard deadline within 24h.

P2.meaning: Do this week. Important but not blocking; deadline within the sprint.

P3.meaning: Backlog / when time permits. No near deadline and no dependency on it.

leadership.meaning: Requested by or visible to leadership (EM / skip-level / staff / exec). Bump one priority level and surface first.
leadership.detect: requester or @-mention is a manager, lead, or exec in the profile's org/team context

external.meaning: Involves someone outside the org domain. Higher stakes and slower to unblock.
external.detect: attendee or requester email domain != the company domain

overdue.meaning: Past its due date. Treat as P1 until cleared.

ordering: items flagged leadership or overdue first
then by priority P1 -> P2 -> P3
then by due date ascending (undated last)
within a tie: actionable before to_review before knowledge

rendering.note: Prefix each item with its priority marker, then append any flag markers. Keep one line per item.
